name: Peter is named among the Twelve
summary: Simon, whom Jesus renames Peter, is listed first among the twelve apostles Jesus chooses.

name: Andrew is named among the Twelve
summary: Peter's brother is named among the twelve apostles.

name: James, son of Zebedee is named among the Twelve
summary: James, the son of Zebedee and brother of John, is named among the twelve apostles.

name: John, son of Zebedee is named among the Twelve
summary: John, the son of Zebedee and brother of James, is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Philip is named among the Twelve
summary: Philip is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Bartholomew is named among the Twelve
summary: Bartholomew is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Thomas is named among the Twelve
summary: Thomas is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Matthew is named among the Twelve
summary: Matthew the tax collector is named among the twelve apostles.

name: James, son of Alphaeus is named among the Twelve
summary: James, the son of Alphaeus, is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Thaddaeus is named among the Twelve
summary: Thaddaeus is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Simon the Zealot is named among the Twelve
summary: Simon the Zealot is named among the twelve apostles.

name: Judas Iscariot is named among the Twelve
summary: Judas Iscariot is named last among the twelve apostles, with a note that he would betray Jesus.

name: Jacob blesses Reuben
summary: Jacob blesses Reuben, his firstborn, but withholds the honor of that birthright.

name: Jacob blesses Simeon
summary: Jacob blesses Simeon, rebuking him for violence.

name: Jacob blesses Levi
summary: Jacob blesses Levi, rebuking him for violence alongside Simeon.

name: Jacob blesses Judah
summary: Jacob blesses Judah with royal leadership over his brothers.

name: Jacob blesses Zebulun
summary: Jacob blesses Zebulun to dwell by the seashore.

name: Jacob blesses Issachar
summary: Jacob blesses Issachar, comparing him to a strong donkey.

name: Jacob blesses Dan
summary: Jacob blesses Dan, comparing him to a serpent in the road.

name: Jacob blesses Gad
summary: Jacob blesses Gad, comparing him to a raiding band that strikes back.

name: Jacob blesses Asher
summary: Jacob blesses Asher with rich food.

name: Jacob blesses Naphtali
summary: Jacob blesses Naphtali, comparing him to a doe set free.

name: Jacob blesses Joseph
summary: Jacob blesses Joseph abundantly as his favored son.

name: Jacob blesses Benjamin
summary: Jacob blesses Benjamin, comparing him to a ravenous wolf.

name: Genesis
summary: Creation, the fall, the flood, and the patriarchs from Abraham to Joseph.

name: Exodus
summary: Israel's slavery in Egypt, the plagues, the exodus, and the giving of the law at Sinai.

name: Leviticus
summary: Priestly law: sacrifices, purity, and holiness for Israel.

name: Numbers
summary: Israel's census and forty years of wandering in the wilderness.

name: Deuteronomy
summary: Moses' final addresses renewing the covenant before Israel enters Canaan.

name: Joshua
summary: Israel conquers and divides the promised land under Joshua.

name: Judges
summary: A repeating cycle of Israel's unfaithfulness and rescue by raised-up judges.

name: Ruth
summary: A Moabite widow's loyalty and redemption, becoming David's great-grandmother.

name: 1 Samuel
summary: Israel's first king Saul rises and falls as David is anointed.

name: 2 Samuel
summary: David's reign as king over Israel, his triumphs and his failures.

name: 1 Kings
summary: Solomon's reign and temple, then the kingdom splits in two.

name: 2 Kings
summary: The divided kingdoms' decline, ending in exile to Assyria and Babylon.

name: 1 Chronicles
summary: Israel's genealogies and David's reign, retold for a returning exile community.

name: 2 Chronicles
summary: Solomon through the exile, retold with a focus on the temple and the kings of Judah.

name: Ezra
summary: Exiles return from Babylon and rebuild the temple in Jerusalem.

name: Nehemiah
summary: Nehemiah leads the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls despite opposition.

name: Esther
summary: A Jewish queen in Persia risks her life to save her people from genocide.

name: Job
summary: A righteous man's suffering and his dialogue with friends and with God.

name: Psalms
summary: Israel's collected songs and prayers of praise, lament, and trust.

name: Proverbs
summary: Short sayings of practical wisdom for a godly life.

name: Ecclesiastes
summary: The Preacher's search for meaning in a life 'under the sun'.

name: Song of Solomon
summary: A love poem celebrating romance between a husband and wife.

name: Isaiah
summary: A major prophet warns Judah of judgment and promises a coming servant and Messiah.

name: Jeremiah
summary: The weeping prophet warns Judah of coming judgment and Babylonian exile.

name: Lamentations
summary: Five poems mourning the destruction of Jerusalem.

name: Ezekiel
summary: A prophet in exile sees visions of judgment and of Israel's future restoration.

name: Daniel
summary: Daniel and his friends stay faithful in exile, and Daniel sees visions of future kingdoms.

name: Hosea
summary: A prophet's unfaithful marriage pictures God's steadfast love for unfaithful Israel.

name: Joel
summary: A locust plague becomes a warning of the coming day of the Lord.

name: Amos
summary: A shepherd-prophet condemns Israel's injustice and empty religion.

name: Obadiah
summary: The shortest Old Testament book pronounces judgment on Edom.

name: Jonah
summary: A reluctant prophet flees, is swallowed by a great fish, then preaches to Nineveh.

name: Micah
summary: A prophet condemns injustice and foretells a ruler born in Bethlehem.

name: Nahum
summary: A prophecy of judgment against the cruelty of Nineveh.

name: Habakkuk
summary: A prophet questions God about injustice and learns to trust him.

name: Zephaniah
summary: A warning of judgment on Judah alongside a promise of future restoration.

name: Haggai
summary: A prophet urges the returned exiles to finish rebuilding the temple.

name: Zechariah
summary: Visions encouraging the rebuilding of the temple and looking to a future king.

name: Malachi
summary: The last Old Testament prophet rebukes Israel's half-hearted worship.

name: Matthew
summary: Jesus presented as the promised Jewish Messiah and king.

name: Mark
summary: A fast-paced account of Jesus as the suffering servant.

name: Luke
summary: A carefully researched account of Jesus, with special attention to the outcast.

name: John
summary: Jesus presented as the divine Word made flesh, through signs and 'I am' sayings.

name: Acts
summary: The Holy Spirit comes at Pentecost and the church spreads from Jerusalem to Rome.

name: Romans
summary: Paul's fullest letter explaining sin, faith, and salvation by grace.

name: 1 Corinthians
summary: Paul corrects division and disorder in the church at Corinth.

name: 2 Corinthians
summary: Paul defends his ministry and calls for reconciliation with the Corinthians.

name: Galatians
summary: Paul defends salvation by faith alone against demands to follow the law.

name: Ephesians
summary: Paul describes the church as one body united in Christ.

name: Philippians
summary: A joyful letter from prison encouraging humility and contentment.

name: Colossians
summary: Paul exalts the supremacy of Christ over every false teaching.

name: 1 Thessalonians
summary: Paul encourages a young church and teaches about Christ's return.

name: 2 Thessalonians
summary: Paul corrects confusion about the day of the Lord and urges steady work.

name: 1 Timothy
summary: Paul instructs a young pastor on church order and sound teaching.

name: 2 Timothy
summary: Paul's final letter urges Timothy to guard the gospel and endure hardship.

name: Titus
summary: Paul instructs Titus on appointing elders and teaching sound doctrine on Crete.

name: Philemon
summary: Paul appeals to Philemon to welcome back his runaway slave as a brother.

name: Hebrews
summary: Christ is presented as superior to the old covenant's priests and sacrifices.

name: James
summary: Practical instruction on living out genuine faith through works.

name: 1 Peter
summary: Peter encourages suffering Christians to stand firm in hope.

name: 2 Peter
summary: Peter warns against false teachers and affirms Christ's certain return.

name: 1 John
summary: John assures believers of genuine faith through love, obedience, and truth.

name: 2 John
summary: A short letter warning against welcoming false teachers.

name: 3 John
summary: A short letter commending hospitality shown to traveling teachers.

name: Jude
summary: A short letter urging believers to contend for the faith against false teachers.

name: Revelation
summary: John's visions of Christ's ultimate victory and the new heaven and earth.
